text: Enemies of the Celestial Empire shall face Heaven's wrath.
Enchanted fire-jars filled with rendered whale oil and phosphorus powder are hurled forth by gunpowder, forming a tongue of flame.

From a high platform, the cultivator channels the amplifying power of enchanted jade to unleash a Gentle Breeze Incantation upon the enemy, forming a small but powerful vortex that deals severe damage to any lone enemy caught within.
These improved rockets, also known as Emerging Divine Dragons, boast exceptional range and destructive power, annihilating any enemy infantry that falls within their reach.
Servants armed with short bows peer out from hidden alcoves of the tower, loosing poisoned arrows to harry the enemy.
Several catapults are arrayed within the tower, crowded further still by frazzled serfs.
A bloated, reeking "old daisy" is flung by a powerful sling, splattering flesh and stench in all directions among the enemy—low in damage, but supremely humiliating.
A mighty divine blade streaks forth, carrying the goddess's blessing to banish all evil and impurity.
A blazing fireball is launched from the tower, sweeping over nearby enemies in a swirling vortex.
A specialized magma cannon fires projectiles down upon the enemy from on high, precisely melting their infantry.
Shrieking rockets with razor-sharp tips are propelled by gunpowder, dealing devastating blows to large enemies.
A meteor drifting slowly across the sky will be the last splendor the enemy ever beholds.
Molten metal will melt through enemy armor, leaving even a fully armored knight as exposed as if bare-chested before it.
Fireballs fall like an infernal downpour, delivering a devastating baptism to any clustered horde of living things.
The hellcannon, empowered by shadow, hungers for countless souls.
Gathering the power of the four Chaos Gods, it is more than enough to crush any counterattack from mere vermin.
These massive bolts were originally forged to hunt the great beasts of Naggaroth, and make short work of any large enemy.
Screams of hatred and agony ceaselessly echo from within the tower, followed by a gaze that unleashes a devastating explosion.
A massive cannon array salvaged from a Black Ark batters foolish enemies like a crashing tide.
A blow condensed from dark power, powerful enough to destroy anything that dares peer upon Har Ganeth.
That one flew pretty far just now, but where'd my wine bottle go?
Without iron teeth and steel jaws, what kind of beast would dare swallow this little flying hammer?
What'd you say? More water—I mean ale, ale!
A massive powder keg packed with high explosives, its surface etched all over with runes of ruin.
Several grenade launchers positioned atop the tower provide support to the Empire's steadfast infantry lines.
The already-calibrated mortar stands ready to fire at any moment; a precise area strike can send infantry scattering in panic.
A relentless stream of cannonballs is more than enough to pierce through several riders at once, pulverizing great beasts into mincemeat.
A beam of magical energy swiftly takes shape within a towering magic spire, unleashing a ray of banishment to destroy the Empire's foes.
Heh heh heh, we'll treat 'em real nice—wait 'til they're stuffed full before we go chop 'em up.
The lads go screeching through the air, giving the enemy a good hard hug!
Eat dis fist! No wait, dis foot!
The Asur are not well-suited to archery within cramped stairwells, and can only harass approaching enemies as best they can.
The scattering bolts of the Eagle Claw Bolt Thrower punch through enemy infantry with tremendous force, and even a heavily armored Chaos Warrior can hardly withstand several hits.
The elven princess has mastered the secret of the volley; her enchanted arrows inflict massive piercing casualties.
Several mages channel a magical missile that shatters the enemy the instant it strikes.
Broad-shouldered brutes atop the tower vent their frustration at being unable to join the melee in a frenzy of rage.
Oooh, more skulls! If there's no heads left, I'll just go down and twist one off myself!
Massive clusters of skulls burst apart in midair, raining death down like a downpour.
No one knows why the Blood God rages so fiercely, and none dare face his wrath directly either.
Icebound guardians stationed atop the tower loose arrows that slow the enemy's advance.
Deep winter greets invading enemies with a kiss of death.
An oversized Arabyan cannon is mounted atop the bell tower, ringing the alarm in its own particular way.
The power of Ursun will sweep over all who set foot upon Kislev as enemies.
Skinks lie hidden within the jungle, weakening the enemy with their blowpipes.
Spinning fire-jars flung through the air are the Skinks' specialty, perfectly suited for wiping out clustered enemies.
A pillar of fire from an ancient creature deals immense armor-piercing damage.
A massive solar engine is mounted atop the temple spire, its beam of light embodying the will of the ancients.
The cold winds of the Northern Wastes, carrying Tzeentch's mockery, extinguish the vital signs of every southerner.
Clean? Hoho—bacteria are born of the belly.
Rotting heads of the dead tumble forth, dragging their targets down into festering decay along with them.
What? This ain't filth, this is a mouthful of concentrated bile!
Rolling Nurglings, dripping with delicious juices, deliver the Father's gift to visiting guests.
Notsobad's got plenty o' junk—chuck it down and pick it back up, and it'll shine even brighter!
The lead-spewer scratches his belly, a fat cigar in his mouth—but the big iron tube in his hands is no joke.
When this useless junk lands on an enemy's head, even the greedy Tyrant, who only has eyes for treasure, has to give a thumbs up!
This massive bronze cannon has smashed the heads of countless Titans, and now it thunders through the valley once more.
Don' — don't hold it upside down, it's — it's over, throw it, THROW IT NOW!
Move — move it, get outta the way!!!
Zzzt zzzt, kill, kill, DIE, DIE!
Th— this is a— a a, big Horned Rat fireworks show!
The twisted towers of Slaanesh always bristle with a few spears, and none struck by them keep their color.
When a dense volley of javelins falls upon the enemy ranks, they always seem to find the strangest of places to land.
Slicing shards flay the enemy's flesh like a death by a thousand cuts, leaving them lost in their own agony.
Isn't the greatest agony that hazy, unreachable dream of yours?
The Wraith of the Netherworld silently drags away any who dare draw near the sea of sand.
Shrieking skulls burst forth in succession, scattering unleashed vengeful spirits in every direction.
A massive bone bow is capable of firing arrows that pierce through any scale of armor.
Can you feel it? The ancient curse from the golden desert sands.
Dense clusters of Dreadfiends grow upon this tower, cackling as they hurl warpfire from their hands.
Warpfire capable of melting any flesh and metal of the mortal world erupts forth; enemies burned by it are twisted into monstrous mutations.
Oh, just look at that sky full of blue flame—guess how many will get caught in it!
Do you see it now? The truth of the world—yes, open your eyes wide!
Plenty of gunpowder! Can you even call it a battlefield without the smell of smoke?
This soul-forged shot is more than enough to punch through the fragile decks and confidence of mankind!
Should you find yourself facing a tempest at the level of the soul, how then would you cope?
Same caliber, too! Long live the Queen!
This bone is no ordinary find—jagged and angular, taken from who knows what manner of creature.
Within the gloomy tower, a gaze of Nagash's own power is unleashed.
Wailing spectral spirits are imprisoned within a cold iron cage—none would dare withstand the twin assault upon both flesh and soul.
Erupt forth, death! Spread wide, decay!
Several mighty thrown spears pierce through nearby enemies—their only shortcoming being a rather limited range.
The Waywatchers' volleys are conjured forth through magical arrays, battering any enemy like a raging downpour.
The Hunting God's arrows will pursue and slay any prey that stumbles into the trap.
Doom-tipped darts carry the resentment of the deep forest, ensuring that any enemy, whatever their kind, becomes nourishment for Athel Loren.
